api_findings.authority_problem: The actual Docker client Popen is not the model worker PID. Protected termination-fence objects cannot be rebranded as ordinary A91 observations or recovered from arbitrary JSON. A new ordinary hook needs its actual own container identity/cleanup observation.

api_findings.observes: Runner-local receipt dictionary after the router invocation; invocation UUID is generated in that runner.
